        **Title**: SpargeAttn: Accurate Sparse Attention Accelerating Any Model Inference
        **Abstract**: An efficient attention implementation is essen-
tial for large models due to its quadratic time
complexity. Fortunately, attention commonly ex-
hibits sparsity, i.e., many values in the attention
map are near zero, allowing for the omission
of corresponding computations. Many studies
have utilized the sparse pattern to accelerate at-
tention. However, most existing works focus on
optimizing attention within specific models by
exploiting certain sparse patterns of the atten-
tion map. A universal sparse attention that
guarantees both the speedup and end-to-end
performance of diverse models remains elu-
sive. In this paper, we propose SpargeAttn,
a universal sparse and quantized attention for
any model. Our method uses a two-stage on-
line filter: in the first stage, we rapidly and ac-
curately predict the attention map, enabling the
skip of some matrix multiplications in attention.
In the second stage, we design an online softmax-
aware filter that incurs no extra overhead and fur-
ther skips some matrix multiplications. Experi-
ments show that our method significantly acceler-
ates diverse models, including language, image,
and video generation, without sacrificing end-to-
end metrics. The codes are available at https:
//github.com/thu-ml/SpargeAttn. 1

**Core Innovation:**  
SpargeAttn introduces a universal sparse and quantized attention mechanism that accelerates diverse model inferences by efficiently predicting and filtering non-zero attention entries, thereby reducing unnecessary computations without compromising end-to-end performance.

**Technical Approach:**  
- **Two-stage Online Filtering:**  
  1. **Attention Prediction:** Uses a fast and accurate method to predict which attention entries are non-zero.  
  2. **Softmax-Aware Filtering:** Applies a filter that skips computations based on predicted sparse patterns, ensuring no extra overhead.  

- **Quantization:** Reduces precision to minimize memory usage and computation time.  
- **Efficient Matrix Multiplications:** Skips computations for zero entries, significantly speeding up attention calculations.  

**Quantitative Findings:**  
1. **Speedup Metrics:**  
   - Language models achieve 1.83x speedup on L40 GPU.  
   - Additional experiments on image and video generation demonstrate similar or higher efficiency.  
   - End-to-end metrics show no loss in performance, with inference time improvements varying between 1.5x and 3x across different models.  

**Limitations & Assumptions:**  
- Assumes the sparsity pattern is consistent across different model architectures and datasets.  
- Requires additional memory for storing sparse masks, which may affect deployment on memory-constrained devices.  
- The method is most effective when the attention mechanism is based on dot-product operations.  

**Domain Impact:**  
- **Theoretical:** Provides a universal solution for sparse attention, applicable across various domains such as natural language processing, computer vision, and speech recognition.  
- **Practical:** Enables faster inference for large models, making it suitable for real-time applications and edge devices, thus improving computational efficiency across industries.
